topic: A repeatable publishing checklist for an independent educational creator
audience: Solo educational creators who already have an audience and publish weekly
problem: Preparing each publication from scratch creates missed checks, unclear ownership and inconsistent follow-through.

sources.title: Original example editorial workflow
sources.text: This is an original fictional exercise, not market research. A useful publication checklist names the intended reader, the reader's question, the source supporting each factual claim, the person checking accuracy, the publication date, and the follow-up task. Work can be split into prepare, publish and review. A weekly retrospective compares what was planned with what actually happened. Reader feedback is a source of ideas, but does not itself prove willingness to pay. A simple worksheet can contain the columns task, owner, due date, evidence and result.
